name: Gayatri Kashyap
title: Frontend Developer
bio: I'm Gayatri Kashyap, a Frontend Developer with an MCA degree and hands-on experience building modern, responsive, and user-friendly web applications. I work with React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, and Bootstrap to create scalable and high-performance interfaces. I enjoy transforming ideas into engaging digital experiences through clean, reusable code and thoughtful UI design. I'm also familiar with REST API integration, state management, authentication, and modern frontend development practices.
